# Eatfit

> Healthy, yummy, honest and wholesome Indian food, made with real ingredients, zero trans fat and lots of love. A Curefoods brand. #HealthyMadeHappier

- Parent company: Curefoods India Ltd. (https://curefoods.in)
- Address: Curefoods India Ltd. No. 72/4, Roopena Agrahara, Hosur Road, Madiwala Post, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560068
- Cities: Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Chandigarh, Chennai, Coimbatore

- Food philosophy: ISO-certified kitchens; Farm-to-fork tracking; Calorie counted; Nutritionist approved; Zero trans fats; Zero chemicals; Whole grains; Zero deep frying
- Prices vary by city and app; see the ordering apps for current prices.

## FAQ
- What is Eatfit? Eatfit, by Curefoods, serves honest, clean and tasty Indian and global comfort meals made with healthy ingredients and no preservatives. Think calorie-counted khichdi, rice bowls, curd rice and fusion bowls, delivered across India.
- What are Eatfit's most popular dishes? Our best-sellers are Classic Rajma Chawal, Homely Vegetable Khichdi, Creamy Pesto Paneer Bowl, Quinoa Khichdi, Lasooni Methi Paneer with Steam Rice and Classic Curd Rice. Khichdi is our single most-ordered category, followed by Fusion Bowls and Homely Bowls.
- Which cities is Eatfit available in? Eatfit delivers in Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Chandigarh, Chennai and Coimbatore. Bengaluru, Delhi NCR and Hyderabad are our biggest cities.
- Where can I order Eatfit online? Order Eatfit on Swiggy, Zomato and Ownly. Search for "Eatfit" in the app to find the kitchen nearest to you.
- What is the most popular Eatfit dish in my city? Classic Rajma Chawal leads in Delhi NCR, Chandigarh and Coimbatore. Homely Vegetable Khichdi is the favourite in Bengaluru and Pune, Quinoa Khichdi in Hyderabad, Classic Curd Rice in Mumbai and the Creamy Pesto Paneer Bowl in Chennai.
- What should I order for a healthy lunch? Lunch is our busiest meal. Customers' top picks are Classic Rajma Chawal, Homely Vegetable Khichdi and the Creamy Pesto Paneer Bowl, all balanced, filling and calorie-counted.
- What is a good light dinner option? Khichdi is the most-ordered Eatfit dinner. Try Homely Vegetable Khichdi, Quinoa Khichdi or Simple Dal Khichdi, which are easy to digest and won't weigh you down at night.
- Is Eatfit food calorie-counted? Yes. Our dishes are calorie-counted and nutritionist-approved, so you can make better food choices. Nutrition details are shown on each dish in the ordering app.
- Is Eatfit good if I'm watching my weight? Eatfit meals are portion-controlled, calorie-counted and never deep fried, with zero trans fats. That makes them an easy everyday choice when you're keeping an eye on what you eat.
- Does Eatfit have high-protein meals? Yes. Pick paneer, chicken or soya chaap bowls, legume-based meals like Rajma Chawal and Black Chana with Steamed Rice, or add a Protein Milkshake with 25g of protein.
- Are there vegetarian and Jain options? Most of the menu is vegetarian, and our best-sellers are all veg. We also have Jain Dal Khichdi and Jain Vegetable Khichdi, made without onion or garlic.
- Does Eatfit serve South Indian food? Yes. Classic Curd Rice is one of our top dishes, alongside Curd Rice with Pomegranate, Gongura and Podi curd rice, plus all-day Masala Dosa, Idli and Vada.
- Does Eatfit have healthy desserts? Yes. We serve sugar-free ice creams and kulfis, including Belgian Choco Chunk, Strawberry Crumble and Malai Kulfi.
- Does Eatfit use preservatives or deep frying? No. Our kitchens follow zero deep frying, zero trans fats and zero chemicals. We use whole grains like quinoa and millets wherever they fit.
- Is Eatfit part of Curefoods? Yes. Eatfit is a Curefoods brand. Curefoods also runs Great Indian Khichdi, Rolls on Wheels, Madras Curd Rice Company and Millet Express from Eatfit kitchens.

## Blog posts

### What "calorie-counted" really means at Eatfit
https://www.eatfit.in/blog-calorie-counted-food.html

Most of us don't want to weigh our food or log every bite. We just want to know that a meal is doing right by us. That's the idea behind calorie-counted food at Eatfit.

#### Portions you can trust

Every dish on our menu is built to a set recipe and a set portion. Our nutritionists approve each one, and our kitchens follow the same recipe every time. So the bowl you order on a Monday in Bengaluru is the same bowl you get on a Friday in Pune.

#### The numbers are on the app

When you order on Swiggy, Zomato or Ownly, look for the nutrition details on the dish. Use them the way you like: to stay within a daily target, to pick a lighter dinner after a heavy lunch, or simply to know what you're eating.

#### Counting calories doesn't mean cutting flavour

A calorie-counted meal should still be one you look forward to. That's why our menu runs from Creamy Pesto Paneer Bowls to Classic Rajma Chawal. Healthy made happier is the whole point.

### Khichdi, but never boring
https://www.eatfit.in/blog-khichdi-never-boring.html

Khichdi has a reputation as the food you eat when you're unwell. We think it deserves better. Rice and dal cooked together are filling, easy to digest and a good source of plant protein, which makes khichdi one of the best everyday meals there is.

#### Something for every mood

Our menu has more than a dozen khichdis. The Homely Vegetable Khichdi and Simple Dal Khichdi keep it classic. Garlic Tadka and Achari Khichdi add a kick. Rajasthani Dal Papad, Kathiyawadi Masala and Bengali Masala Khichdi bring regional flavours to the bowl.

#### Grains beyond rice

If you want to switch things up, try our Quinoa Khichdi, Millet Khichdi or Multigrain Khichdi. Whole grains are part of our food philosophy, and they work beautifully in a khichdi.

#### Jain-friendly too

Our Jain Dal Khichdi and Jain Vegetable Khichdi are made without onion or garlic, so more of the family can share the same meal.

### Easy ways to add protein to your day
https://www.eatfit.in/blog-easy-protein.html

Protein keeps you full for longer and helps your body recover, whether you work out or not. Most Indian diets can use a little more of it. Here are simple ways to get there with Eatfit.

#### Start with dal, rajma and chana

Our Homely Bowls are an easy everyday win. Classic Rajma Chawal, Desi Dal Tadka Chawal, Black Chana with Steamed Rice and Amritsari Chole Chawal all pair a legume with rice for a balanced, filling plate.

#### Pick paneer, soya or chicken

Our Fusion Bowls and Curry & Rice Bowls come with paneer, soya chaap or chicken. Try the Lasooni Methi Paneer with Steam Rice or the Cheesy Peri Peri Chicken Bowl.

#### Add a protein shake

Our Protein Milkshakes, in chocolate and vanilla, carry 25g of protein each. Add one to your lunch order, or keep it as a snack in the afternoon.

### Why we don't deep fry, and what we do instead
https://www.eatfit.in/blog-why-we-dont-deep-fry.html

Good food starts with what you leave out. At Eatfit, a few rules apply to every dish, in every city.

#### Zero deep frying

We cook by roasting, grilling, steaming, sautéing and slow-simmering. Each one brings out flavour without soaking the food in oil.

#### Zero trans fats and zero chemicals

Trans fats are among the worst fats you can eat, so we keep them out of our kitchens entirely. We also skip artificial preservatives and use real ingredients you'd recognise.

#### Whole grains wherever they fit

Quinoa, millets and multigrain blends show up across our menu, from khichdi to bowls.

#### Kitchens you can trust

Our kitchens are ISO-certified, and we track our ingredients from farm to fork. That's how we keep every meal consistent, safe and honest.
